render_messages_sync: render chat messages using the DeepseekV4Renderer with parsed conversation and multimodal prompt data
render_messages_async: asynchronously render chat messages with the DeepseekV4Renderer for non-blocking conversation processing
apply_chat_template: apply the DeepSeek v4 chat template to conversation messages via the renderer tokenizer
initialize_renderer: create a DeepseekV4Renderer instance with a VllmConfig and optional DeepseekV4Tokenizer
parse_dec_only_prompt: parse a raw prompt string into a DictPrompt for the DeepSeek decoder-only model
